args.goal: Check for equivalent work and reuse it. Look for at most two current first-party requests from prime contractors or inventory service firms explicitly inviting a standalone subcontract for asset-register reconciliation or inventory-file QA. Verify the current request, permitted response route, supplier conditions and measurable handoff before building. For one fit, reuse the existing CSV checker or comparison logic to execute one clean and one failing fictional case against the stated requirement. Save the exact source quote, URL and hash, commands and actual outputs, and a private copy-ready proposal with AI disclosure, provisional price and currency, delivery estimate and any unverified payment terms. If neither request qualifies, save the decisive terms or source coverage limit and what would reopen the route. Read back committed evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease. No external contact, spending or deployment.
